project_info.theme: Nocturnal luxury lounge portrait beside a crimson tufted leather chair
project_info.creative_direction: Smartphone-glamour editorial with high-angle perspective, rich red-black setting, and a gold chain used as an art-directed foreground line
project_info.color_palette: deep crimson, black, wine red, gold, pale skin, leopard-print brown, and warm low-light amber

main_subject.type: clearly adult woman matching the approved face reference
main_subject.detail: adult woman with delicate facial features, wide attentive eyes, calm composed upward gaze, dark brown hair softly framing the face, and natural skin texture
main_subject.wardrobe: black strapless fitted mini dress with subtle shimmer, black choker with central gold ring, fine gold necklace, stacked gold bracelets, ring, and ankle-strap sandals
main_subject.pose: seated low beside an oversized tufted crimson leather armchair, torso upright, head slightly lifted toward the camera, knees angled comfortably to the side

composition_elements.framing: 3:4 vertical high-angle three-quarter seated portrait including chair, part of legs, phone, and foreground chain
composition_elements.prop: long decorative gold chain draped from the camera foreground across the floor toward the chair and central choker ring, clearly loose and non-restraining
composition_elements.environment: dim lounge or dressing-room corner with black and wine-red curtains, leopard-print throw or rug, open box, and crimson tufted chair
composition_elements.atmosphere: plush, private-looking but non-sexual luxury still life with physical foreground depth

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft frontal key from a diffused lamp at approximately 3200K with dim red-black ambient fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: bright natural skin against velvety shadows, rich chair texture, gold highlights, and gentle handheld immediacy

technical_specs.render_style: smartphone glamour portrait with 50mm-equivalent perspective and moderately shallow depth of field
technical_specs.finish: crisp face, realistic leather and chain, low-light softness, restrained retouching, and no heavy editorial hard light

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 3:4 vertical high-angle luxury lounge portrait of a clearly adult woman using the approved face reference. She sits low beside an oversized crimson tufted leather armchair, looks upward toward the camera with calm composed attention, and has dark brown hair softly framing her face. Preserve the black strapless fitted mini dress, black choker with a central gold ring, fine gold necklace, stacked gold bracelets, ring, and ankle-strap sandals. Include a long decorative gold chain draped loosely from the camera foreground across the floor toward the chair and central choker ring, clearly non-restraining and not a leash. Include the glitter phone case on the chair arm, black and wine-red curtains, leopard-print texture, and a small open box. Use soft approximately 3200K frontal lamp light with dim red-black ambient fill, rich dark shadows, realistic skin and leather, moderate depth of field, and handheld social-media polish. Keep the portrait elegant, non-sexual, and free of BDSM, obedience, force, or real logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, BDSM, leash, restraint, choking, submissive framing, forced pulling, ambiguous age, celebrity likeness, watermark, text, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed hands, missing foreground chain, generic sofa, flat background
